summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of its Q1 2026 Pillar 3 documents for its large subsidiaries, including NatWest Holdings, NatWest Markets, National Westminster Bank, The Royal Bank of Scotland, and Coutts Company. These Pillar 3 disclosures are routine regulatory capital and risk management reports required under UK prudential standards, notifiable to the SEC for foreign private issuers. The filing contains no event or transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a standard periodic update with no special-situation relevance.
